_comments: #371 item 21: labels that still read as column names on the Deal form and the grids.
For a foreign key the label is set on the VIRTUAL NAME FIELD (LeadSourceType, OwnerEmployee,
FromDealStatusType, ...), not the ...ID column: mj-form-field reads RelatedEntityNameFieldMap first and
grids show the name field. .deal-field-labels.json explains this in full. Plain columns are labelled
on themselves.
AutoUpdateDisplayName goes to 0 so the label is a deliberate choice, not re-derived from the column
name. Labels are read from metadata at runtime; no generated code changes for them.
Stage history grid. ToDealStatusType is labelled with FromDealStatusType so the two read as a pair.
#371 item 24: Influence had no description, so nothing said its unit or range and an out-of-range
value surfaced as the raw CK_DealContactRole_Influence error. The CHECK allows 0 to 100; the column
is DECIMAL(5,2). The column has no extended property, so AutoUpdateDescription goes to 0 or CodeGen's
schema sync would put NULL back.

fields.Description: How much this contact sways the buying decision, from 0 (none) to 100 (decides alone). Up to two decimal places.

_comments: #371 item 23: the old description promised a Board flag that did not exist yet. The Board's rotting
flag reads this column (#450), and the description now says what it does. The column carries an
extended property with the old wording, so AutoUpdateDescription goes to 0 or CodeGen's schema sync
would restore it.

fields.Description: Deals that stay in this stage longer than this many days are flagged on the Board. Empty means no flag.

_comments: #371 item 23: Entry Criteria and Required Fields are editable on the Pipeline Stage form but nothing
reads them. They leave the generated form; the columns stay so existing data is kept and a later
feature can use them. IncludeInGeneratedForm is read by CodeGen when it writes the form, so the field
disappears from the committed form on the next CodeGen run, not on push alone.
#371 item 24: the Sales Contact form showed both 'Seniority' and 'Seniority Level ID'.
SeniorityLevelID is the live field: it is inherited from Common's People (bizapps-common v5.45.x)
and points at the shared SeniorityLevel type table that every app reads. Seniority is sales' older
free-text column; no sales code reads it. It leaves the generated form (the column and its data stay),
and SeniorityLevelID takes the plain label, set on its row in .sales-contact-field-labels.json so one
file owns that field's label. As above, the form changes on the next CodeGen run.
